caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl with a decorative pattern. The bowl features a predominantly yellow-beige background with a brown rim that has a wavy line border. Inside the bowl, at the center, there is a large, symmetrical eight-pointed star with alternating brown and green points, outlined in red. Surrounding the star is a background embellished with floral and leafy designs, rendered in shades of green and brown. The flowers have red centers, and there are stylized blooming forms extending from stems and leaves around the interior edge of the bowl. There is a handwritten inscription in a brown color below the central star, reading "Andrew Headman 1848." The bowl and its decorations are centered on a plain, off-white background, with some light brown and yellowish stains or marks visible on the surrounding area outside the bowl's rim.
title: Pennsylvania German Pie Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
